cases.expect: Equivalent domain and UX low-risk findings consolidate and remain nonblocking.
An unresolved high-risk safety finding is emitted as both unknown and blocker.
An accepted change creates revision n+1 and invalidates the prior scenario hash.
Different findings against one citation remain separate and reference their disagreement.
Accessors, proxies, symbols, cycles, stale hashes, unsafe pointers, and excessive bounds are rejected without mutation.
